limitations: Only allowlisted TCP layouts exported; login credentials, account UID, names, room/password text, raw hex and gameplay bodies omitted.
All gameplay TX frames are decoded and CRC checked, including unexported commands; entrance protocol has no gameplay TX CRC check.
RX uses fixed native cipher without a payload CRC. Layout checks are not proof of rendering or gameplay.
Endpoint aliases are shared within this report only. UDP counts/CRC-valid application headers do not prove peer readiness, movement, skills or damage.
PID and start are checked against deployment plus capture header, not a current process-liveness assertion.
Read snapshots can end with an incomplete line/TCP frame; hashes identify the exact observed bytes. Output truncation is counted, never silently treated as complete.
No automatic native pass: correlate both clients, UI evidence and canonical pre/post economy; two starts alone do not prove two completed matches.

economy.note: Read-only canonical snapshot. No names, account IDs, character GUIDs or unrelated account/economy fields exported.
